text:
alex: Quick sync — Q2 hosted capacity planning. We need a decision on new GPU commits vs short-term leases by Fri. High-level ask: figure out target GPU-hours, region split, and fallback plan for the winter/holiday surge.
priya: timeline noted. can we get a demand curve first? last quarter's surge surprised us.
marco: I pushed the forecast from the prediction model — baseline + 20% conservative for promotional spikes. headroom needed ~120k GPU-hours for Q2 if we want <50ms p50 for standard gen.
jenna: budget constraints: finance can reallocate up to $350k capex for buys, or $220k/month OPEX for leases. which side buys more?
omar: cluster health note: EU-west has persistent network tail at 0300 UTC during maintenance windows. if we put extra capacity there we'll need cross-region fallback.
alex: good call. priya, can you share the utilization telemetry? specifically p50/p95 tokens/sec and GPU saturation rates for hosted prod in Jan+Feb.
priya: paste of recent metrics below. short version: p95 token throughput up 37% YoY; avg gpu_util by instance type: h200: 61%, a800: 74%.
priya: ```
# last 30d summary
region: us-west2 | model-class: mix | tokens/sec p50: 18k | p95: 46k | avg gpu_util: 68%
region: eu-west  | model-class: small | tokens/sec p50: 9k  | p95: 21k | avg gpu_util: 59%
inference mix: 40% chat, 45% completion, 15% embeddings
expected growth: base 12% q/q, promo surge +25% for 3 weeks
```
marco: fwiw the heavy tail requests are long sequences (1k+ context) — those drive KV cache pressure and force larger batch windows. latency-sensitive routes still need reserved capacity.
jenna: if we buy H200s at $28k/GPU list, with discounts we can get ~$22k. lease per month ~ $1.8k/GPU (1yr). simple calc: buy breaks even at ~12 months.
alex: can we run a quick scenario matrix? buy vs lease for 150 GPUs vs 300 GPUs across two regions (us/eu). keep it short.
priya: here's a minimal trade-off I sketched: ```
scenario A: buy 150 H200s -> capex ~ 3.3M (discounted), opex ops+power ~ $18k/mo
scenario B: lease 150 H200s -> opex ~ $270k/mo
scenario C: buy 300 -> capex ~ 6.6M
scenario D: hybrid buy 120 us + lease 60 eu -> mix cost
Notes: reserved capacity reduces autoscale pressure and lowers tail latency; leases give flexibility for promo surge.```
omar: operational risk: ordering new hardware -> 8-12 week lead time. leases available in <2 weeks but higher monthly cost. also need cross-region bandwidth config for cache coherence if split.
marco: throughput projection for promo: to keep p50 <60ms we need ~20% extra effective GPUs (KV cache hit rates assumed 15% better if we pre-warm hotspots). that reduces required physical GPUs by ~10%.
jenna: finance preference: smaller capex and predictable opex. we prefer lease/hybrid. but CFO will approve buys if ROI within 9 months.
alex: proposal: 1) approve hybrid: buy 100 H200 for core US serving, lease 100 in EU for seasonal/risk 2) enable cross-region fallback routing + warm cache strategy 3) a 6-week re-eval.
priya: configurables: batch windows, prefix cache TTL, autoscale scale-up aggressiveness. those knobs can buy us ~8-12% effective capacity cheaply.
omar: checklist for execution: - procurement SOW for 100 units - lease quotes from 3 vendors - network runbook for cross-region fallback - alerting on regional tail spikes
capacity-bot: @here procurement reminder: quotes needed by 2026-03-12.
marco: quick test we should run: synthetic long-context workload to measure KV cache warmup time and p95 delta. can someone own that?
priya: i'll own synthetic run. will post results Tue.
jenna: I'll draft the financial scenarios and show monthly cashflow impact; need the lease quotes to finalize.
alex: thanks. decision target = 2026-03-15. anyone object to proposal above or have alternative?
omar: one ask: include a contingency of 15% spare capacity for incident absorption (we had only 5% last holiday).
marco: agree to contingency. also recommend a canary routing policy to shift load if EU tail spikes.
jenna: noted — will include contingency in the financials.
alex: great. next steps: priya run tests, jenna gather lease vs buy numbers, omar draft network runbook. we'll reconvene Thu 11am PT. :thumbsup:
